about: Exact-match source patches applied IN THE PLAYER'S BROWSER to their own copy of Balatro 1.0.1x. Contains no game code beyond the short anchor strings needed to locate each edit.

patches.label: load web shim first
patches.find: if (love.system.getOS() == 'OS X' ) and (jit.arch == 'arm64' or jit.arch == 'arm') then jit.off() end

patches.label: skip Steam (luasteam)
patches.find: if os == 'OS X' or os == 'Windows' then

patches.label: non-blocking error handler
patches.replace:
function love.errhand(msg)
	if __WEB then __WEB.on_error(msg) return end

patches.label: web platform flags
patches.replace:
self.F_MOBILE_UI = false
    self.F_SOUND_THREAD = false
    self.F_SAVE_TIMER = 5
    self.F_CRASH_REPORTS = false
    self.F_QUIT_BUTTON = false
    self.F_VIDEO_SETTINGS = false
    self.MIN_CLICK_DIST_WEB = true

patches.label: silence LONG DT spam
patches.find: if self.real_dt > 0.05 then print('LONG DT @ '..math.floor(G.TIMERS.REAL)..': '..self.real_dt) end

patches.label: web window + save identity
patches.replace:
t.window.minheight = 100
	t.identity = 'balatro-web'
	t.window.resizable = true
	t.window.highdpi = true

patches.label: skip-intro option from the shell
patches.replace: if G.SETTINGS.skip_splash == 'Yes' or (__WEB and __WEB.opts and __WEB.opts.skip_splash) then

patches.label: frame-rate cap from the shell
patches.replace: G.FPS_CAP = (__WEB and __WEB.opts and __WEB.opts.fps_cap) or G.FPS_CAP or 500
